item.title: Democratic Senate candidates use debates to rev engines in race
item.description: <p>The top three Democratic U.S. Senate candidates faced off twice last week.</p><p>The <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/elections/2026/01/26/senate-debate-sun-times-wbez-uchicago-krishnamoorthi-stratton-kelly" >first debate</a> wasn’t televised, so the live audience was quite small. The second debate was televised, so the audience was bigger.</p><p>However, these debates don’t attract even a smidgen of the audience of presidential debates, when half the country often tunes in.

item.title: Man, 38, killed in Garfield Park shooting
item.description: <p>A 38-year-old man died Friday afternoon after he was shot in Garfield Park, Chicago police said.</p><p>The man was shot twice — in the chest and in the abdomen — about 4:45 p.m. Friday in the 700 block of South Pulaski Road, police said. </p><p>He was taken to Mount Sinai Hospital in critical condition and was later pronounced dead.</p><p>A 22-year-old man was taken into custody at the scene, and a gun was recovered, police said. </p>
